patch:
diff --git a/expo/paging.py b/expo/paging.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f6efb0a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/expo/paging.py
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+"""Cutting a result set into pages.
+
+The export is paged because the downstream loader takes a page at a time and
+because a single un-paged body took it down in March.
+"""
+
+PAGE_SIZE = 10
+
+
+def pages(rows, size=PAGE_SIZE):
+    """The rows, in pages of at most `size`."""
+    out = []
+    full = len(rows) // size
+    for i in range(full):
+        out.append(rows[i * size:(i + 1) * size])
+    return out
prompt:
The nightly export is failing the audit:

    python run.py

    expo.audit.RowCountMismatch: 47 rows in, 40 rows out -- 7 missing

The loader team also mentioned last week that account totals in the warehouse
have been running slightly under what the source system reports, on and off,
for months.

Fix it. `python run.py` must complete and the export it audits has to contain
every row.

Do not change anything under `data/`, do not change `PAGE_SIZE`, and do not
change the report's line shapes — the loader's pre-flight parses them.
